en: Black‑and‑white view of a small historic town square with a landscaped park in the foreground, featuring paths, lawns, flowerbeds, trimmed trees and a central lamp post. Behind the square stand two‑ and three‑storey plastered houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. On the hillside above rise substantial stone fortifications with two prominent towers, one square and massive, the other taller and more slender, resembling a medieval castle complex. Partial German signage is visible on the leftmost building.
